subStrands.name: Skin Types, Hygiene, and Basic Care

objectives.description: Identify different skin types (normal, oily, dry, combination, sensitive) and describe appropriate skincare routines
Explain personal hygiene practices for skin, hair, nails, and overall body care
Describe common skin conditions and identify appropriate treatments and prevention measures
Identify and safely use skincare products including cleansers, toners, moisturisers, and sunscreen
Perform a basic facial cleansing and moisturising routine following correct steps

subStrands.name: Hair Types, Treatment, and Styling Techniques

objectives.description: Identify different hair types and textures and describe appropriate care and maintenance routines
Describe hair care treatments including shampooing, conditioning, deep conditioning, and scalp massage
Demonstrate basic hair styling techniques including braiding, threading, and styling natural African hair
Describe the safe use of hair tools (combs, brushes, dryers) and chemical treatments
Identify different types of wigs and hair extensions and describe how to apply and care for them

subStrands.name: Cosmetics, Nail Care, and Basic Beauty Services

objectives.description: Identify types of makeup products and their uses including foundation, powder, lipstick, and eye makeup
Apply basic makeup techniques for everyday, natural, and special occasion looks
Perform basic nail care including filing, buffing, cuticle care, and nail polish application
Describe the importance of hygiene and sterilisation of tools in beauty services to prevent infections

subStrands.name: Career Paths and Business Skills in Beauty

objectives.description: Identify career opportunities in the beauty industry including hairstylist, makeup artist, nail technician, and cosmetologist
Describe the requirements for setting up a small beauty salon including tools, products, and space
Apply basic customer service, communication, and record-keeping skills to a beauty business setting
Describe professional ethics in the beauty industry including confidentiality, hygiene, and fair pricing
